Changes.note: “Add” enrols the Medaris accounts of the listed addresses in this course without waiting for approval; their waiting applications are approved, and an approval notification reaches them. Those newly added are not notified; while the course is published, its sessions’ calendar invitations come by e-mail. People who are barred, were taken out of the course or have completed it are not added. The addition is written to the audit log with its counts and is not undone as a whole: a talebe is taken out from the Enrolled tab, with a reason.
